name: Corridor Survey and LiDAR
description: Topographic and corridor baseline survey from Sydney fringe to Wollongong.
educational_note: Early data quality reduces rework and often supports critical-path design tasks.

name: Geotechnical Borehole Program
description: Boreholes, lab tests, and geotechnical model refinement.
educational_note: Ground uncertainty can drive critical-path tunnelling decisions.

name: Land Acquisition Package
description: Negotiate and acquire required corridor parcels.
educational_note: Delays may create float loss for downstream construction starts.

name: Environmental Impact Statement
description: Prepare and lodge NSW planning and environment package.
educational_note: Approval path can become critical when statutory windows are tight.

name: Community Consultation Round 1
description: Engagement with local councils and communities.
educational_note: Strong consultation can reduce later opposition-driven delays.

name: Bridge Preliminary Design
description: Concept-to-preliminary bridge structural design.
educational_note: Bridge design sits on major dependency chains for civil works.

name: Tunnel Preliminary Design
description: Alignment, support class, and tunnel systems design basis.
educational_note: Tunnel design is commonly critical due to complexity and risk.

name: Ground Improvement and Earthworks
description: Ground treatment and formation earthworks on priority segments.
educational_note: Often includes non-critical sections with usable float if staged.

name: Major Materials Procurement
description: Procurement of steel, concrete systems, and long-lead items.
educational_note: Long-lead procurement can become critical if late.

name: Bridge Construction Package A
description: Construct northern bridge package structures.
educational_note: Extended duration means bridge works can dominate the critical path.

name: Tunnel Construction Package A
description: Drive and support key tunnel sections.
educational_note: Tunnel package delays often directly shift project completion.

name: Station Civil Works
description: Core civil packages at selected station interfaces.
educational_note: May carry float if systems integration is not yet gating.

name: Track Slab and Rail Installation
description: Install track slab, sleepers, and rail sections.
educational_note: Track laying is usually near-critical after civil completion.

name: Signalling and Control Installation
description: Install signalling hardware and control interfaces.
educational_note: Can run parallel with track in some zones, creating potential float.

name: Overhead and Power Integration
description: Power systems, overhead line interfaces, and substations.
educational_note: Integration packages reveal sequencing constraints from earlier stages.

name: Operations Control Centre Fitout
description: Fitout and test operational control facilities.
educational_note: Short tasks can have slack but still matter for readiness.

name: Network-Wide System Integration
description: Full integrated systems proving across corridor packages.
educational_note: Integration quality determines testing reliability and can become critical.

name: Safety Assurance and WHS Certification
description: Formal safety case and WHS compliance closure.
educational_note: Regulatory tasks can be critical despite short duration.

name: Testing and Commissioning
description: End-to-end technical testing under operating scenarios.
educational_note: Late-stage defects can reduce available float to near zero.

name: Trial Operations
description: Pilot operations with timetable and incident drills.
educational_note: Final gateway task is often on the critical path by definition.

name: Community Consultation Round 2
description: Late-stage community readiness and communications campaign.
educational_note: Often has float relative to technical completion but affects acceptance metrics.

name: Environmental Compliance Closeout
description: Confirm offsets, monitoring and approval conditions completion.
educational_note: Compliance closeout can delay opening if left unscheduled.
